prompt:
You are an industrial process monitoring engineer. The Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) shows an abnormal episode. Your task: identify the root cause.

Dataset: Tennessee Eastman Process simulation. Columns: XMEAS_1..41 process measurements, XMV_1..11 manipulator variables (Downs-Vogel standard mapping). Sampling: 3 minutes. Fault onset: sample 161 of 960.
Blind statistical monitoring results (computed from the data):
- Per-column max |z|-score (top columns): XMEAS_22 max|z|=4 (0.3% beyond 3σ); XMEAS_11 max|z|=3.97 (0.3% beyond 3σ); XMEAS_4 max|z|=3.95 (0.4% beyond 3σ); XMEAS_15 max|z|=3.53 (0.2% beyond 3σ); XMV_8 max|z|=3.53 (0.3% beyond 3σ); XMEAS_3 max|z|=3.52 (0.3% beyond 3σ)
- Strongest cross-domain correlations: XMEAS_12 ~ XMV_7: r=1.000; XMEAS_15 ~ XMV_8: r=1.000; XMEAS_17 ~ XMV_11: r=-1.000; XMEAS_9 ~ XMV_10: r=0.998; XMEAS_1 ~ XMV_3: r=0.996; XMEAS_7 ~ XMEAS_13: r=0.992

Process description: Tennessee Eastman 化工过程：反应器-冷凝器-气液分离器-汽提塔+循环压缩机。XMEAS_1..41 过程测量、XMV_1..11 操纵变量。3分钟采样，第161样本（8h）起进入异常工况。

Task: identify the root cause of this abnormal episode. Output STRICT JSON only (no markdown, no extra text): {"top3": ["<root cause id/name>", ...], "reasoning": "<2-3 sentences>"} where top3 is your ranked list of up to 3 candidate root causes.

top3: IDV(14): Reactor cooling water valve sticking
IDV(15): Condenser cooling water valve sticking
IDV(11): Reactor cooling water inlet temperature (random variation)
answer.reasoning: The episode shows only low-amplitude, diffuse deviations (max |z|≈4 with ~0.3% of samples beyond 3σ), which is the classic signature of a hard-to-detect valve stiction/sticking fault rather than a large feed or composition step. The largest excursions sit on the cooling/heat-transfer side (XMEAS_22 condenser cooling-water outlet temperature, XMEAS_11 product separator temperature, plus temperature-control loop pairings such as XMEAS_15~XMV_8 and XMEAS_12~XMV_7), consistent with a sticking cooling-water valve degrading reactor/condenser temperature control; hence IDV(14) (reactor cooling water valve sticking) is the most likely root cause, with IDV(15) and cooling-water inlet temperature disturbances (IDV(11)) as nearest alternatives.
